subject: Daz
fact: Daz would note the locked safe without regret.
source_quote: Daz would note it without regret: we are not the famed Whistler, no safecracker of that old generation among us.

subject: Glabbagool

subject: Bookwyrm
fact: Bookwyrm's chambers took half the top floor — comfortable, neatly arranged, no extravagance to it.

subject: Midnight Tears
fact: The name Midnight Tears was kept where it would not be lost.
source_quote: Midnight Tears. I kept the name where I would not lose it.

subject: We
fact: We had several leads: a cage missing three birds, jars of blistered rats, a page marked to a poisoning by gift.
source_quote: We had several. A cage missing three birds. Jars of blistered rats. A page marked to a poisoning by gift.
